text: In this town, when someone forgets you, you start turning grey.
His keys. His glasses. Sometimes, even my name.
Mom says one day, he'll forget me completely.
This morning, my hand started turning grey.
I ran all the way to his house.
He was sitting by the window, holding an old photo.
My best friend. I forget everything. But never him.
And my hand turned warm again.
Then I noticed. Grandpa's hands were grey.
Everyone in town had forgotten him.
Except me. So now, I visit him every single day.
